# Toolome — full tool data

> Curated, hand-verified directory of AI tools for biology. 302 tools. Source: https://toolome.bio/

## Single-cell & foundation models

### scGPT

Generative pretrained transformer foundation model for single-cell multi-omics.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/scgpt/
- Website: https://github.com/bowang-lab/scGPT
- GitHub: https://github.com/bowang-lab/scGPT
- Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02201-0 (Nature Methods 2024)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: foundation-model, transformer, annotation
- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### Geneformer

Transformer pretrained on ~30M single-cell transcriptomes for network biology predictions.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/geneformer/
- Website: https://huggingface.co/ctheodoris/Geneformer
- Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06139-9 (Nature 2023)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: foundation-model, transfer-learning
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### scvi-tools

Probabilistic deep generative models for single-cell omics (scVI, totalVI, scANVI...).

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/scvi-tools/
- Website: https://scvi-tools.org
- GitHub: https://github.com/scverse/scvi-tools
- Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-021-01206-w (Nature Biotechnology 2022)
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: vae, integration, python
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### CellTypist

Automated cell type annotation with logistic regression models trained on curated atlases.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/celltypist/
- Website: https://www.celltypist.org
- GitHub: https://github.com/Teichlab/celltypist
- Paper: https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.abl5197 (Science 2022)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: annotation, immune
- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### Scanpy

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/scanpy/
- Website: https://scanpy.readthedocs.io
- GitHub: https://github.com/scverse/scanpy

- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### scFoundation

100M-parameter foundation model trained on 50M human single-cell transcriptomes.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/scfoundation/
- Website: https://github.com/biomap-research/scFoundation
- GitHub: https://github.com/biomap-research/scFoundation
- Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02305-7 (Nature Methods 2024)
- License: Apache-2.0 (code; model weights under separate terms)
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: foundation-model
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### Tahoe-x1

Perturbation-trained single-cell foundation models up to 3B parameters, pretrained on Tahoe-100M and fine-tuned for cancer tasks.

- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### Stack

Arc Institute model trained on 149M human cells using tabular attention for in-context learning; used to generate the Perturb Sapiens atlas (28 tissues, 201 perturbations).

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/stack/
- Website: https://arcinstitute.org/news/foundation-model-stack
- GitHub: https://github.com/ArcInstitute/stack
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.01.09.698608 (bioRxiv preprint 2026)
- License: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (code); Arc non-commercial (model)
- Pricing: Open source (non-commercial)
- Tags: foundation-model, in-context-learning, perturbation
- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### Virtual Cell Challenge 2026

Arc Institute's perturbation benchmark: predict CRISPRi knockdown responses in six cell lines never seen perturbed, from their unperturbed state alone.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/virtual-cell-challenge-2026/
- Website: https://arcinstitute.org/news/virtual-cell-challenge-2026
- License: NOASSERTION
- Pricing: No cost (research use)
- Tags: perturb-seq, benchmark, virtual-cell
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

- License: no license detected by GitHub
- Pricing: Research release

- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### GLUE

Graph-linked variational autoencoders that integrate unpaired single-cell multi-omics data and infer regulatory interactions.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/glue/
- Website: https://github.com/gao-lab/GLUE
- GitHub: https://github.com/gao-lab/GLUE

- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: bioinformatics, deep-learning, single-cell
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### CellBender

Deep generative model that removes ambient RNA and other technical background from droplet scRNA-seq count matrices.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/cellbender/
- Website: https://cellbender.rtfd.io
- GitHub: https://github.com/broadinstitute/CellBender
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01943-7 (Nature Methods 2023)
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: single-cell
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### ivis

Siamese neural network for structure-preserving dimensionality reduction of very large single-cell datasets.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/ivis/
- Website: https://beringresearch.github.io/ivis/
- GitHub: https://github.com/beringresearch/ivis
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.01596 (Journal of Open Source Software 2019)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: machine-learning, data-visualization, dimensionality-reduction
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### SingleCellNet

Random-forest classifier on gene pairs that assigns cell types to scRNA-seq data across species and platforms.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/singlecellnet/
- Website: https://github.com/CahanLab/singleCellNet
- GitHub: https://github.com/CahanLab/singleCellNet
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2019.06.004 (Cell Systems 2019)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: single-cell
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### scDblFinder

Doublet detection for single-cell data using gradient-boosted trees trained on artificial doublets.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/scdblfinder/
- Website: https://plger.github.io/scDblFinder/
- GitHub: https://github.com/plger/scDblFinder
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.12688/f1000research.73600.2 (F1000Research)
- License: GPL-3.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: single-cell, doublets
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### scDeepSort

Pretrained weighted graph neural network for cell-type annotation of scRNA-seq data.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/scdeepsort/
- Website: https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab775
- GitHub: https://github.com/ZJUFanLab/scDeepSort
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab775 (Nucleic Acids Research 2021)
- License: GPL-3.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: single-cell, transcriptomics, deep-learning
- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### Cell2Sentence (C2S-Scale)

Turns expression profiles into ranked gene "cell sentences" so LLMs (up to 27B) can model and generate single-cell data.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/cell2sentence/
- Website: https://github.com/vandijklab/cell2sentence
- GitHub: https://github.com/vandijklab/cell2sentence
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.09.11.557287 (bioRxiv preprint)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: single-cell
- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### CytoVI

Deep generative model in scvi-tools that integrates flow cytometry, mass cytometry and CITE-seq data across panels, with protein imputation, differential expression and annotation.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/cytovi/
- Website: https://docs.scvi-tools.org/en/stable/user_guide/models/cytovi.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/scverse/scvi-tools
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03224-5 (Nature Methods 2026)
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: cytometry, vae, integration
- Last checked: 2026-10-17

### Cellist

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/saprot/
- Website: https://github.com/westlake-repl/SaProt
- GitHub: https://github.com/westlake-repl/SaProt
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.10.01.560349 (bioRxiv preprint)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: alphafold2, foldseek, predicted-structures
- Last checked: 2026-10-16

### Efficient Evolution

Uses general protein language models to recommend affinity-improving mutations, applied to human antibodies.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/efficient-evolution/
- Website: https://github.com/brianhie/efficient-evolution
- GitHub: https://github.com/brianhie/efficient-evolution
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01763-2 (Nature Biotechnology 2024)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: protein
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### FoldingDiff

Diffusion model that generates protein backbones by denoising internal backbone angles.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/foldingdiff/
- Website: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-45051-2
- GitHub: https://github.com/microsoft/foldingdiff
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.15611 (arXiv preprint 2022)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: diffusion, diffusion-models, protein
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### STARLING

Latent diffusion model that predicts coarse-grained conformational ensembles of intrinsically disordered regions from sequence.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/starling/
- Website: https://github.com/idptools/starling
- GitHub: https://github.com/idptools/starling
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10141-2 (Nature 2026)
- License: no license detected by GitHub
- Pricing: Research release
- Tags: protein
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### TAPE

Benchmark of five protein tasks with pretraining corpus and pretrained language model weights for evaluating protein embeddings.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/tape/
- Website: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/676825v1
- GitHub: https://github.com/songlab-cal/tape
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.08230 (arXiv preprint 2019)
- License: BSD-3-Clause
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: deep-learning, protein-sequences, protein-structure
- Last checked: 2026-10-20

### DISCO

Diffusion model that co-designs protein sequence and structure conditioned on ligands, DNA or RNA.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/disco/
- Website: https://disco-design.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/DISCO-design/DISCO
- License: Apache-2.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: diffusion-models, enzyme-design, protein-design
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### Raygun

Template-based protein design: edits an existing protein by insertions, deletions and substitutions while keeping its fold and function.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/raygun/
- Website: https://github.com/rohitsinghlab/raygun
- GitHub: https://github.com/rohitsinghlab/raygun
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10842-8 (Nature 2026)
- License: no license detected by GitHub
- Pricing: Research release
- Tags: protein
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### ODesign

All-atom generative world model for designing proteins, ligands, nucleic acids and cyclic peptides that bind a given target.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/odesign/
- Website: https://github.com/OTeam-AI4S/ODesign
- GitHub: https://github.com/OTeam-AI4S/ODesign
- License: no license detected by GitHub
- Pricing: Research release
- Tags: protein
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### FrameDiff (SE(3) diffusion)

SE(3) diffusion model for protein backbone generation over residue frames.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/se3-diffusion/
- Website: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.02277
- GitHub: https://github.com/jasonkyuyim/se3_diffusion
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.02277 (arXiv preprint 2023)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: protein
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### BioEmu2

Foundation model for biomolecular structure and dynamics: structure prediction, equilibrium ensemble sampling and time-lagged trajectory generation for proteins, nucleic acids and ligands.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/bioemu2/
- Website: https://github.com/microsoft/bioemu2
- GitHub: https://github.com/microsoft/bioemu2
- License: MIT (code and bioemu2-preview weights MIT (README and Hugging Face model card))
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: dynamics, ensembles, generative, structure-prediction
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### RFD4-Proteina

Flow-matching model from the Baker lab and NVIDIA that co-designs protein sequence and all-atom structure, covering binders, antibodies, enzymes and small-molecule pockets, with reward-guided search.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/rfd4-proteina/
- Website: https://rfd4-proteina.org/
- GitHub: https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFD4-Proteina
- Paper: https://rfd4-proteina.org/assets/paper/RFD4-Proteina.pdf (Preprint 2026)
- License: BSD-3-Clause (code BSD-3-Clause; Hugging Face weights BSD-3-Clause)
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: protein-design, flow-matching, all-atom, antibody
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### Pinal

Westlake University model that designs protein sequences from a natural-language description: a text-to-structure model (T2struc) proposes structure tokens, then SaProt-T writes the sequence.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/pinal/
- Website: http://www.denovo-pinal.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/westlake-repl/Denovo-Pinal
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11205-z (Nature 2026)
- License: Apache-2.0 (code Apache-2.0 (GitHub LICENSE))
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: protein-design, text-to-protein, protein-language-model
- Last checked: 2026-10-23

AI-ready DDA mass-spectrometry corpus (1.54B MS/MS spectra, 548M PSMs, 35 species) in a Parquet tensor format (MSDT), plus XuanjiNovo, a non-autoregressive transformer for de novo peptide sequencing trained on 100M PSMs.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/massnet/
- Website: https://guomics.com/software/massnet
- GitHub: https://github.com/guomics-lab/MassNet-DDA
- Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03247-y (Nature Methods 2026)
- License: Apache-2.0 (code and XuanjiNovo weights Apache-2.0 (per paper and repo LICENSE))
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: mass-spec, de-novo, dataset, transformer
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

- License: Apache-2.0
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: llm, reasoning, medical
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### Lingshu

Alibaba DAMO's multimodal medical LLMs (7B/32B) for medical image understanding, reasoning, VQA and report generation.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/lingshu/
- Website: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/lingshu/
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07044 (arXiv preprint 2025)
- License: MIT (weights)
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: multimodal, llm, medical-imaging
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### Merlin

Stanford's 3D vision-language model for abdominal CT, pretrained on scans, EHR codes and radiology reports for classification, retrieval and report generation.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/merlin/
- Website: https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Merlin
- GitHub: https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Merlin
- Paper: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10181-8 (Nature 2026)
- License: MIT
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: ct, vision-language, radiology
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### MeditronFO (Fully Open Meditron)

EPFL's fully open medical LLMs (open weights, training data and recipe) built on Apertus, OLMo-2, EuroLLM and Gemma-3 bases.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/meditronfo/
- Website: https://huggingface.co/collections/EPFLiGHT/meditronfo
- GitHub: https://github.com/EPFLiGHT/FullyOpenMeditron
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16215 (arXiv preprint 2026)
- License: Apache-2.0 (code; weights follow each base model (Apache-2.0 for Apertus/OLMo/EuroLLM, Gemma terms for Gemma-3))
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: llm, fully-open, clinical-decision-support
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### NV-Reason-CT

NVIDIA's 3D vision-language model for chest and abdominal CT: structured reports, visual QA and step-by-step reasoning.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/nv-reason-ct/
- Website: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NV-Reason-CT
- GitHub: https://github.com/NVIDIA-Medtech/NV-Reason-CT
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27511 (arXiv preprint 2026)
- License: OpenMDW-1.1 (weights)
- Pricing: Open source
- Tags: ct, vision-language, radiology
- Last checked: 2026-10-22

### BiomedGPT

Generalist vision-language foundation model for biomedical images and text, covering VQA, captioning, report generation and classification.

- Page: https://toolome.bio/tools/biomedgpt/
- Website: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-024-03185-2
- GitHub: https://github.com/taokz/BiomedGPT
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.17100 (arXiv preprint 2023)
- License: Apache-2.0 (README: code and checkpoints strictly for academic research; commercial use prohibited)
- Pricing: Open source (non-commercial)
- Tags: clinical
- Last checked: 2026-10-22
